description: "The Two Hundredth Anniversary of the Settlement of the Town of New Milford, Conn." by Daniel Davenport is a historical account written during the early 20th century. This publication commemorates the bicentennial of the town’s establishment, reflecting on the early settlers' challenges and triumphs in a harsh and untamed wilderness.
